caption: An avant-garde art-punk track driven by a sléndro-informed pentatonic pitch field, 3:2 rhythmic coupling, and obsessive glottal stops. A trashy, high-energy lead vocalist and distorted echo group battle through a panic-under-function state, backed by fluorescent ballast hums, shift-register noise, magnetic tape loops, cristal baschet glass resonances, and dry body percussion.
